SECTION VII
IRREVERSIBLE ENVIRONMENTAL CHANGES
To a large extent, the irreversible commitment of the land to urban uses, which is generally implied by construction projects, has already been made for these projects. In the case of the construction of the Alma Neighborhood Center, there will be a permanent commitment to the urban use of an undeveloped parcel of land.
In conjunction with the commitment of land, there is also an irreversible commitment of materials and energy to construct and maintain structures on the land.
The added consumption of these resources is proposed as part of an overall program to reverse the trend of decline in the health and safety of the affected neighborhoods.
The project is not of such a nature that accidents associated with construction or operation are likely to cause irreversible environmental damage.
